lines.en: label secondbeach4:
scene ocean
We make our way out of the inn and it quickly becomes evident that Otoha regrets not dressing appropriately for the occasion.
lines.zh: 我们走出旅馆，很快就看出来 Otoha 在后悔没为这种场合穿对衣服。

lines.en: I think about letting her borrow my blazer, but then decide even offering it is pointless because, if it {i}really{/i} gets too cold for her, she can always zip her hoodie up.
lines.zh: 我想过把西装外套借给她，但转念一想，连开口提议都毫无意义——要是她{i}真{/i}冷得受不了，大可以把连帽衫的拉链拉上。

lines.en: Though, I really hope she doesn’t.
lines.zh: 不过，我真心希望她别拉。

lines.en: We walk in silence along the shoreline, trying to find somewhere to talk without anyone else seeing us, and I can’t help but find myself staring at her out of the corner of my eye.
lines.zh: 我们沿着海岸线沉默地走着，想找个没别人看得见的地方说话，而我忍不住用余光打量她。

lines.en: And either she’s okay with it or just doesn’t notice because, even though I’m barely being discreet about it, she doesn’t say anything.
lines.zh: 要么她无所谓，要么她根本没注意到——因为我几乎毫不掩饰，她却一句话都没说。

lines.en: I think more about what could have possibly prompted her to invite me out, knowing that she’s perhaps less interested in me than even someone like Yumi-
lines.zh: 我越想越好奇，到底是什么促使她把我叫出来，心里清楚她对我的兴趣，大概比连 Yumi 这样的人还要少——

lines.en: And then I land on one thing and one thing only.
lines.zh: 然后我只想到一件事，仅仅一件事。

lines.en: Rin.
lines.zh: Rin。

lines.en: How boring.
lines.zh: 真没劲。

lines.en: Which isn’t to say that Rin herself is boring. I like her a lot.
lines.zh: 倒不是说 Rin 本人无趣。我挺喜欢她的。

lines.en: It’s just the idea of someone inviting me out to talk about romantic companionship (Or lack thereof) that doesn’t even involve me seems rather pointless in the long run.
lines.zh: 只是「被人叫出来，谈一段跟我毫无关系的恋爱（或者没有恋爱）」这件事，长远来看实在没什么意义。

lines.en: But hey, people like to talk.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，人就是爱说。

lines.en: Otoha, if nothing else, is certainly a person.
lines.zh: Otoha 别的不好说，她确实是个「人」。

lines.en: A person who is likely going to try and figure out a way out of something bound to happen whether anyone wants it to or not-
lines.zh: 一个很可能正试图从某件注定要发生的事里找出路的人——不管别人愿不愿意——

lines.en: But a person nonetheless.
lines.zh: 但她终究还是个人。

lines.en: And I have zero chance of sleeping with her in the future if I dismiss her over something as trivial as this.
lines.zh: 而且要是我为了这种鸡毛蒜皮的小事就把她打发走，以后跟她上床的机会就是零。

lines.en: If there is anything that walking alongside her on this beach has reinforced in my head, it is the desire to do just that.
lines.zh: 如果说和她并肩走在这片海滩上让我更加确信了什么，那就是我很想那么做。

lines.en: But hey, maybe I’ll get really lucky and find out in this impromptu meeting that Otoha is just really horny and wants me to fuck her before anyone realizes we’re gone.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，也许我运气特别好，会在这场临时会面里发现 Otoha 只是欲火难耐，想在有人发现我们失踪之前让我操她。

lines.en: That would be the best case scenario.
lines.zh: 那就是最好的情况了。

lines.en: Unfortunately, I don’t think I’ve encountered something that convenient since I first arrived in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是，自从我来到 Kumon-mi，好像还没碰上过这么便宜的事。

lines.en: Oh well.
lines.zh: 算了。

lines.en: I’ll just listen and hope that there’s something I can contribute to this conversation.
lines.zh: 我就听着吧，希望这趟对话里能有我插得上嘴的地方。

lines.en: And store the sight of another sheltered girl’s fair skin in my mind to help me cum whenever I’m feeling lost or alone.
lines.zh: 顺便把又一个涉世未深的女孩那白皙的皮肤记进脑子里，好在我迷茫或孤独的时候帮我射出来。

lines.en: : This should be fine, right?
lines.zh: ：这儿应该可以吧？

lines.en: : Yeah.
scene black
scene otohabananaboat1
: Interesting choice of location.
lines.zh: ：地点选得挺有意思。

lines.en: : Why? Because it’s a boat shaped like a banana?
lines.zh: ：为什么？因为这是一艘香蕉形状的船？

lines.en: : That’ll do it.
lines.zh: ：就是这个原因。

lines.en: : It’s whatever.
lines.zh: ：随便吧。

lines.en: : Not really sure what a random banana boat thing is doing in the middle of a circle of palm trees on the beach, but I was getting tired of walking, so...
lines.zh: ：我也不知道这种莫名其妙的香蕉船为什么会出现在海滩上一圈棕榈树中间，不过我走累了，所以……

lines.en: : Maybe it’s a cult ritual site of some sorts.
lines.zh: ：也许是某种邪教仪式场所。

lines.en: : Like one of you girls secretly worships a banana-shaped god and set up this boat as a means of contacting him.
lines.zh: ：比如说你们某个女生偷偷崇拜一位香蕉形状的神，还弄了这条船来当和祂沟通的工具。

lines.en: : Maybe.
lines.zh: ：也许吧。

lines.en: : Or maybe somebody just left it here.
lines.zh: ：或者只是有人把它落在这儿了。

lines.en: : My idea was significantly more exciting.
lines.zh: ：我的想法可带劲多了。

lines.en: scene otohabananaboat2
: More exciting, sure. A hell of a lot less plausible, though.
lines.zh: ：带劲是带劲，可可信度低得不是一星半点。

lines.en: : Otoha...you didn’t call me out here to talk about bananas, did you?
lines.zh: ：Otoha……你把我叫出来，不是来聊香蕉的吧？

lines.en: scene otohabananaboat3
: Of course not. I don’t even like bananas.
lines.zh: ：当然不是。我连香蕉都不喜欢。

lines.en: : Rin is going to be very happy when she hears that.
lines.zh: ：Rin 听到这个一定会很高兴。

lines.en: scene otohabananaboat4
: Dude.
lines.zh: ：老兄。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: ：怎么？

lines.en: : You should be happy I made that joke. I saved you a segue.
lines.zh: ：你该庆幸我开了这个玩笑。我帮你省了一段过渡。

lines.en: scene otohabananaboat5
: Hah...yeah. Yeah, you did.
lines.zh: ：哈……是啊。是啊，你是省了。

lines.en: : Figured you would have known that’s what this was about.
lines.zh: ：我就知道你猜得到这是要聊什么。

lines.en: : What about her, though?
lines.zh: ：不过她怎么了？

lines.en: : You two have a complicated relationship, so I figure it could be almost anything.
lines.zh: ：你们俩的关系挺复杂，所以我猜什么都有可能。

lines.en: scene otohabananaboat6
: You think {i}we{/i} have a complicated relationship? Because, at least from my perspective, the one you guys have seems a lot more complicated than just two girls who hang out and talk about music.
lines.zh: ：你觉得{i}我们{/i}关系复杂？至少在我看来，你们那边的可比「两个一起玩、聊聊音乐的女生」复杂多了。

lines.en: : I think Rin sees a little more in you than just a musician friend, Otoha.
lines.zh: ：我觉得 Rin 看你的眼光，可不止是一个玩音乐的朋友，Otoha。

lines.en: scene otohabananaboat7
: I obviously know that. But that’s all we are right now and that’s all we’ll be for a while.
lines.zh: ：我当然知道。但现在我们就是这样，而且在一段时间内也只会是这样。

lines.en: : That’s not exactly what I’m thinking about right now, though.
lines.zh: ：不过我现在想的倒不是这个。

lines.en: : Are you going to tell me what you’re thinking? Or are we just going to hang out on a giant banana?
lines.zh: ：你到底要不要告诉我你在想什么？还是我们就打算一直待在这根巨大的香蕉上？

lines.en: scene otohabananaboat8
: Stop mentioning the banana.
lines.zh: ：别再提香蕉了。

lines.en: : It is a hard aspect of this conversation to ignore.
lines.zh: ：这是这场对话里很难忽略的一个要素啊。

lines.en: : Then don’t mind if I ignore it and try to move things along because I am getting very cold.
lines.zh: ：那我就忽略它、尽量推进话题了，因为我快冻死了。

lines.en: : Have you like...talked to Rin at all today?
lines.zh: ：你今天……有没有跟 Rin 说过话？

lines.en: : Today? No.
lines.zh: ：今天？没有。

lines.en: : Was she like...acting weird the last time you talked to her or anything?
lines.zh: ：你上次跟她说话的时候，她有没有……表现得有点奇怪什么的？

lines.en: : Weird in what way?
lines.zh: ：怎么个奇怪法？

lines.en: scene otohabananaboat9
: I don’t know.
lines.zh: ：我不知道。

lines.en: : But she’s been acting a little different ever since she pulled you out of class the other day.
lines.zh: ：不过自从前几天她把你从课上叫出去之后，她表现得就有点不一样了。

lines.en: : Did you like...say anything to her or something?
lines.zh: ：你有没有……跟她说了什么之类的？

lines.en: : At the risk of revealing too much information, do you mind if I ask {i}you{/i} why you think she’s acting weird?
lines.zh: ：冒着透露太多信息的风险，我能问问{i}你{/i}为什么觉得她表现得很奇怪吗？

lines.en: scene otohabananaboat10
: So, uhh...
lines.zh: ：那个，呃……

lines.en: : She confessed to Chika or whatever during your last beach trip, right?
lines.zh: ：上次海滩旅行的时候，她跟 Chika 告白了什么的，对吧？

lines.en: : That was certainly a thing that happened.
lines.zh: ：那确实是发生过的一件事。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
: But Chika was, like...into {i}you{/i} or something back then, right?
lines.zh: ：不过那时候 Chika 好像……喜欢{i}你{/i}来着，对吧？

lines.en: : Why do you ask?
lines.zh: ：为什么问这个？

lines.en: : Are you worried Rin still has feelings for her or something?
lines.zh: ：你是担心 Rin 还对她有感觉之类的？

lines.en: : She liked her for years, dude. Am I insane for thinking that all of that would just vanish after spending a couple months hanging out with me?
lines.zh: ：她喜欢了她好几年啊，老兄。我难道是疯了吗，怎么会以为那些感情在跟我混了几个月之后就凭空消失了？

lines.en: : She obviously likes me too, but with how weird she’s been acting lately, I can’t help but feel like she might be...having flashbacks or something to last time.
lines.zh: ：她显然也喜欢我，可她最近表现得那么奇怪，我忍不住觉得她可能是在……闪回上次的事之类的。

lines.en: scene otohabananaboat11
: She’s not really easy to talk to when anything involving romance comes up.
lines.zh: ：只要话题一牵扯到恋爱，她就很难聊。

lines.en: : And I'm sure it's no surprise, but neither am I. I suck at it.
lines.zh: ：而且你肯定也不意外——我也不好聊。我这方面烂透了。

lines.en: : But, not gonna lie, I think that a lot of her problem is a result of how shit went down back then.
lines.zh: ：不过说实话，我觉得她的大部分问题，都是当年那档子事闹的。

lines.en: : Finding out how the person you're into is...into somebody else you're close with is kind of a fucked up thing to deal with.
lines.zh: ：发现你喜欢的人……喜欢的是另一个跟你很亲近的人，这种事处理起来真的挺操蛋的。

lines.en: : That...That probably hurt her a lot.
lines.zh: ：那……那大概把她伤得很深。

lines.en: : I mean...it’s not like I really did anything {i}wrong{/i} though, right?
lines.zh: ：我是说……我其实也没做{i}错{/i}什么吧？

lines.en: : Fuck if I know. I’d prefer to stay as far out of your personal life as I can.
lines.zh: ：我他妈怎么知道。我宁可离你的私生活越远越好。

lines.en: : All I want is to figure out what’s going on so I can...adjust accordingly.
lines.zh: ：我只想搞清楚到底怎么回事，好让我……相应地调整。

lines.en: else:
: I...obviously already know that things with that didn’t really end well, but...is it weird for me to think there might still be something there?
lines.zh: ：我……显然已经知道那件事最后收场得不太好，但是……我总觉得他们之间说不定还有什么，这很奇怪吗？

lines.en: : Do you think that might be why she’s been acting weird lately?
lines.zh: ：你觉得这就是她最近表现得奇怪的原因吗？

lines.en: : Cause she’s having like...PTSD beach flashbacks or something?
lines.zh: ：因为她在……海滩创伤后应激之类的？

lines.en: : Do you think that Rin still has feelings for Chika?
lines.zh: ：你觉得 Rin 还喜欢 Chika 吗？

lines.en: : She liked her for years, dude.
lines.zh: ：她喜欢了她好几年啊，老兄。

lines.en: : I’m no expert on romance, but I don’t think that feelings like that just go away the second someone new shows up.
lines.zh: ：我可不是什么恋爱专家，但我觉得那种感情不会因为一个新的人出现就立刻消失。

lines.en: : Like...you two had a thing for a little while too, didn’t you?
lines.zh: ：就好比……你们俩也交往过一阵子吧？

lines.en: : I don’t know if I’d call it a “thing” when all we did was kiss.
lines.zh: ：我们只是接过吻，我可不确定那能叫「交往」。

lines.en: : Normally, probably not.
lines.zh: ：一般来说，大概不算。

lines.en: : But I think the fact that you’re twice her age kind of {i}makes{/i} it a thing.
lines.zh: ：但我觉得，你年纪是她两倍这件事，{i}让{/i}这就算是「交往」了。

lines.en: : If you had a normal friendship or student-teacher relationship or whatever, things like that wouldn’t happen.
lines.zh: ：要是你们只是正常的友谊或者师生关系什么的，这种事根本不会发生。

lines.en: : I guess what I’m getting at is that there are so many different reasons for her to be acting the way she is and I just...don’t understand any of them.
lines.zh: ：我想说的就是，她会这样有太多不同的原因了，而我……一个都不明白。

lines.en: : And all I want is to figure out what’s going on so I can...adjust accordingly.
lines.zh: ：我只想搞清楚到底怎么回事，好让我……相应地调整。

lines.en: : Well, let me ask you this-
lines.zh: ：那么，我问你一句——

lines.en: : What if the reason Rin’s acting weird is because of you?
lines.zh: ：万一 Rin 表现奇怪的原因就是你呢？

lines.en: scene otohabananaboat12
: I haven’t even done anything differently, though.
lines.zh: ：可我什么都没改变啊。

lines.en: : In fact, I was kinda stoked to spend the weekend hanging out with her.
lines.zh: ：事实上，我还挺期待这个周末能跟她一起玩的。

lines.en: : Rin’s a really awesome and fun girl as long as you figure out how to tune out the...insane amount of hormones.
lines.zh: ：Rin 其实是个又棒又有趣的女生，只要你学会忽略她那……多得离谱的荷尔蒙。

lines.en: : I think the hormones are another thing about her that just makes her as...entertaining as she is.
lines.zh: ：我觉得那些荷尔蒙正是让她变得这么……有看点的一部分。

lines.en: : I have no idea how she still feels about Chika...and I’m probably even more confused about how she feels about me-
lines.zh: ：我完全不知道她对 Chika 现在是什么感觉……而她对我是什么感觉，我大概更摸不着头脑——

lines.en: : But I think the best thing you can do is ignore all of that and just think about how she feels about {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: ：但我觉得你能做的最好的事，就是把这些全都抛开，只想她对{i}你{/i}是什么感觉。

lines.en: scene otohabananaboat13
: It’s not that easy, dude.
lines.zh: ：没那么容易，老兄。

lines.en: : I’ve seen her scars.
lines.zh: ：我见过她的伤疤。

lines.en: : I understand how much she must have been hurting to do something like that to herself.
lines.zh: ：我明白她当时得有多痛，才会对自己做出那种事。

lines.en: : Being the current target for all of her affection...just makes it so that one wrong move on my part could get her to start doin' that shit again.
lines.zh: ：现在她所有的爱意都指向我……这就意味着我只要走错一步，她可能又会开始做那种事。

lines.en: : It's so much pressure.
lines.zh: ：压力太大了。

lines.en: : Like...even if Rin feels a lot stronger about me than I do about her, I still care about her.
lines.zh: ：就好比……就算 Rin 对我的感情比我对她深得多，我还是在乎她。

lines.en: : She deserves happiness just as much as anybody else.
lines.zh: ：她和别人一样，都值得拥有幸福。

lines.en: : And it really fucks me up to see her upset.
lines.zh: ：看她难过，我真的会崩溃。

lines.en: : So, yeah...I kinda just...don’t really know what to do about it.
lines.zh: ：所以，嗯……我大概就是……真不知道该怎么办。

lines.en: : She’s even like...avoiding me now. And that’s never happened before.
lines.zh: ：她现在甚至还在……躲着我。这以前从来没有过。

lines.en: : Feels a lot like a...calm before the storm type of thing.
lines.zh: ：感觉很像那种……暴风雨前的宁静。

lines.en: : And what do you think that storm will be, exactly?
lines.zh: ：那你觉得那场暴风雨会是什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: ：我不知道。

lines.en: : I just hope it isn’t something that gets in the way of our friendship.
lines.zh: ：我只希望它不会妨碍到我们的友情。

lines.en: Ahh...there it is.
lines.zh: 啊……来了。

lines.en: The semi-broodish resistance of a [teenage]girl pushing back a wave of feelings moving far too quickly for her to handle.
lines.zh: 一个[teenage]女生半带忧郁的抗拒，把一波对她来说来得太快的感情推回去。

lines.en: This type of thing is not uncommon in girls Otoha’s age- especially ones without any experience or even apparent interest in love or sex.
lines.zh: 这种事在 Otoha 这个年纪的女生身上并不少见——尤其是那些既没有经验、对爱和性又明显没什么兴趣的。

lines.en: She just wants to enjoy her youth- and that is fine.
lines.zh: 她只是想享受青春——这没什么不好。

lines.en: Unfortunately, it looks like someone may, once again, have to suffer as a result of that.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是，看来又要有人为此受苦了。

lines.en: Maybe it would be best to let Rin know?
lines.zh: 也许最好还是让 Rin 知道？

lines.en: Or, maybe-
lines.zh: 或者，也许——

lines.en: I should let her fail again.
lines.zh: 我该让她再失败一次。

lines.en: Will that failure lead to her giving up on girls entirely?
lines.zh: 那次失败会让她彻底放弃女生吗？

lines.en: Will it land her one step closer to my door?
lines.zh: 会让她离我的门再近一步吗？

lines.en: Will she cry as she lays on my bed in defeat once again?
lines.zh: 她会再一次败下阵来，躺在我的床上哭泣吗？

lines.en: Or will she accept her place in both my life and hers and just learn to let things go?
lines.zh: 还是说她会接受自己在我和她生命里的位置，学会放手？

lines.en: scene otohabananaboat14
: Anyway, I guess I’ll leave you to your giant banana now.
lines.zh: ：总之，我看你就跟你的大香蕉待着吧。

lines.en: : I’m going to go put actual clothes back on and find out whether or not Nodoka lost her virginity to one of the girls who were arrested during our raid earlier.
lines.zh: ：我要去把正常的衣服穿回来，顺便看看 Nodoka 有没有把处女之身交给早些时候我们突袭时被抓的某个女生。

lines.en: : It’s honestly a miracle she still has it to begin with.
lines.zh: ：说实话，她到现在还是处女，本身就是个奇迹。

lines.en: : I think that every single day.
lines.zh: ：我每天都这么想。

lines.en: : Thanks, though.
lines.zh: ：不过，谢了。

lines.en: : And, if you see Rin, can you ask her to at least text me back?
lines.zh: ：还有，要是你见到 Rin，能不能让她至少回我条短信？

lines.en: : Sure thing.
lines.zh: ：没问题。

lines.en: : Have fun checking the virginity status of your roommate.
lines.zh: ：祝你查室友的处女状态愉快。

lines.en: : Have fun with the banana.
lines.zh: ：祝你和香蕉玩得开心。

lines.en: scene otohabananaboat15
Otoha leaves and I wind up “having fun with the banana” for a minute or two.
lines.zh: Otoha 走了，我就这么「和香蕉玩得开心」了一两分钟。

lines.en: Please don’t interpret that the wrong way.
lines.zh: 请不要往歪处理解。

lines.en: I’m really just sitting here thinking about, as Otoha put it, the calm before the storm.
lines.zh: 我真的只是坐在这儿，想着 Otoha 说的那个「暴风雨前的宁静」。

lines.en: I know we only have one other experience to work off of, but it feels like a beach trip without some form of tragedy would be no beach trip at all.
lines.zh: 我知道我们能参照的只有上一次的经历，但我总觉得，一场没有某种悲剧的海滩旅行，根本算不上海滩旅行。

lines.en: scene otohabananaboat16
: Molly?
lines.zh: ：Molly？

lines.en: Right on cue.
lines.zh: 说曹操曹操到。

lines.en: : G...Greetings, Supreme Overlord.
lines.zh: ：您……您好，至高霸主。

lines.en: : How long have you been there for?
lines.zh: ：你在那儿待多久了？

lines.en: : I was...in the middle of leveling up my stealth when...I saw you and Otoha walking, so...
lines.zh: ：我……我正在升级潜行技能，然后……看见你和 Otoha 在走，所以……

lines.en: : So you followed us?
lines.zh: ：所以你就跟过来了？

lines.en: : ...Yeah.
: How much did you hear?
lines.zh: ：你听到了多少？

lines.en: : Not much, Sir. I had to stand rather far away to conceal my presence.
lines.zh: ：不多，先生。我得站得相当远，才能掩饰自己的存在。

lines.en: : I had every intention of leaving you behind and returning to the inn to complete my quest, but...
lines.zh: ：我本来是打算丢下你、回旅馆完成我的任务的，不过……

lines.en: : I...I think I’m leveled up high enough to skip out on the XP for a little while longer.
lines.zh: ：我……我觉得我的等级已经够高了，可以再歇一会儿不去刷经验。

lines.en: : Does this mean it’s {i}our{/i} turn to talk now?
lines.zh: ：这是不是意味着，现在轮到{i}我们{/i}聊了？

lines.en: : May I sit?
lines.zh: ：我可以坐吗？

lines.en: : As long as you’re okay with the seat being a giant banana.
lines.zh: ：只要你不介意座位是一根巨大的香蕉。

lines.en: scene otohabananaboat17
Molly takes a seat on the banana boat and peers up at the sun through the leaves of the palm trees.
lines.zh: Molly 在香蕉船上坐下，透过棕榈叶抬头看了看太阳。

lines.en: As if the idea of the calm before the storm was not enough the first time it was brought up, she had to show up now of all times and remind me of just how much is at stake this weekend.
lines.zh: 就好像「暴风雨前的宁静」这个概念第一次被提出来还不够似的，她偏偏挑这个时候出现，提醒我这周末的赌注有多大。

lines.en: Perhaps {i}everyone{/i} will be damaged beyond repair and I’ll be around to pick up the pieces?
lines.zh: 也许{i}每个人{/i}都会伤到无法修复，而我会留下来收拾残局？

lines.en: Why does the thought of that not excite me even half as much as it should?
lines.zh: 为什么这个念头带给我的兴奋，连应该有的的一半都不到？

lines.en: : Molly-
lines.zh: ：Molly——

lines.en: : I’m already prepared for it, Sir.
lines.zh: ：我已经做好准备了，先生。

lines.en: : Prepared for what?
lines.zh: ：准备好什么了？

lines.en: : TPK.
lines.zh: ：TPK。

lines.en: : A total party kill, rather.
lines.zh: ：准确地说，是团灭。

lines.en: : The only issue is that this druid is currently in between groups and running a party of one.
lines.zh: ：唯一的问题是，这个德鲁伊目前没有队伍，正独自一人组队。

lines.en: : It’s a lonely campaign.
lines.zh: ：这是一场孤独的战役。

lines.en: : But...I’ll be able to start again on a new character soon enough.
lines.zh: ：不过……我很快就能开个新角色重新开始了。

lines.en: scene otohabananaboat18
: I know it’s coming.
lines.zh: ：我知道它要来了。

lines.en: : And I know things do not look good for the main heroine.
lines.zh: ：我也知道，女主角的处境看起来不妙。

lines.en: : But...that’s just the thing with main heroines, Sir.
lines.zh: ：不过……女主角就是这样，先生。

lines.en: : Sometimes, our happiness is pushed back to the very end.
lines.zh: ：有时候，我们的幸福会被一直推到最后。

lines.en: : Perhaps that’s what’s happening this time.
lines.zh: ：也许这一次就是这么回事。
：或者……

lines.en: : Or perhaps I’m no main heroine at all?
lines.zh: ：或者，也许我根本就不是什么女主角？

lines.en: scene otohabananaboat19
: Either way...I’m prepared.
lines.zh: ：不管怎样……我准备好了。

lines.en: : I {i}have{/i} to be prepared.
lines.zh: ：我{i}必须{/i}准备好。

lines.en: : If Rin thinks Otoha is the one who can make her happy...I’ll just have to make someone else happy.
lines.zh: ：如果 Rin 觉得 Otoha 才是能让她幸福的人……那我就去让别人幸福好了。
：我会……

lines.en: scene otohabananaboat20

lines.zh: ：我会……

lines.en: : Damn it...
lines.zh: ：该死……

lines.en: : Would it make you feel better if we hugged on a banana boat?
lines.zh: ：要是我们在这艘香蕉船上拥抱一下，你会不会好受点？

lines.en: scene otohabananaboat21
: Hahah...
lines.zh: ：哈哈……

lines.en: : Maybe for a moment...
lines.zh: ：也许能好受一会儿……

lines.en: : I do...have to be getting back to the Kendo Princess, though.
lines.zh: ：不过我……确实得回到剑道公主身边去了。

lines.en: : She’s embarking on a quest of her own right now that...may or may not have its own set of difficulties.
lines.zh: ：她现在正在踏上属于自己的任务，那个任务……可能有、也可能没有它自己的一堆难题。

lines.en: : A quest of her own?
lines.zh: ：属于她自己的任务？

lines.en: scene black
$ secondbeach4 = True
{i}Meanwhile...further down the shore...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……海岸更远处……{/i}

lines.en: jump secondbeach5
